topics: small-scale adventurous discovery without epic bombast
prompt: Compose an original complete 60-second instrumental cue for small-scale adventurous discovery without epic bombast. Instruments: staccato strings, French horn, timpani, harp. 128 BPM in 4/4. Motif: a rising fourth followed by a descending step. Start the hook and beat immediately; maintain a clear pulse and concise two-bar phrases. One fresh timbral answer halfway through. Keep the groove throughout, then a decisive tonic ending during the last second with a very short natural decay. No slow intro, long outro, riser, silence or fade-out. Mobile-speaker-friendly bass. Instrumental only. No vocals, no choir, no humming, no singing, no speech, no lyrics, no vocal samples. No imitation of any artist, song, film, game or brand.

description.en: A lively and elegant classical-style piece featuring a string ensemble. It begins with a playful pizzicato melody, gradually building in complexity and energy with arco passages and dynamic shifts. The arrangement is sophisticated and engaging, evoking a whimsical yet refined atmosphere.
description.zh: 一首活泼优雅的古典风格乐曲，由弦乐合奏呈现。它以俏皮的拨弦旋律开场，通过弓弦乐段和动态变化逐渐增强复杂性和能量。编曲精致引人入胜，营造出一种异想天开而又不失精致的氛围。
